title: DC-AR: Efficient Masked Autoregressive Image Generation with Deep Compression Hybrid Tokenizer
scope: Text-to-image generation using 2D hybrid tokenizer, masked AR, and residual diffusion; ImageNet is used for tokenizer reconstruction tests
reading_scope: Main text pp.1-8; implementation, safety-filter description, visual examples, further experiments and comparison-boundary appendices pp.13-18; references indexed, not independently verified; rendered p.8 Tables 4-6 checked
caveats: Han project BibTeX incorrectly says arXiv:2410.10733; actual Paper link and downloaded title identify 2507.04947.
12 reported generation steps refer to discrete sampling; Appendix A.2 additionally specifies 20 residual diffusion steps.
Paper excludes VAR-family comparisons and includes internal synthetic training data.
